evals.name: restructure-a-messy-docs-tree
evals.prompt: our docs/ folder has turned into a dump. theres a caching.md thats like 4 different things at once, a setup.md and an api.md. can you sort out how this should actually be organised? dont rewrite the content yet just tell me what goes where and why
evals.expected_output: Identifies the four Diátaxis modes, splits caching.md into explanation/how-to/reference/tutorial parts, places setup.md and api.md, justifies each placement by reader need

evals.name: diagnose-a-single-mixed-page
evals.prompt: people keep complaining they cant find stuff in docs/caching.md. its all accurate though. whats wrong with it?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses mode-mixing rather than writing quality; names which modes are tangled and where each part should go

evals.name: defers-on-an-adr
evals.prompt: i need to write up the decision we made to drop redis in favour of postgres for the job queue, so the next person understands why. where should that live in our docs?
evals.expected_output: Recognises this is a decision record (ADR), not a docs-tree classification problem; does not force it into the four modes, though may note explanation is the closest fit for reader-facing narrative
